mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_comment_link (tenant_id, provider, binding_id, external_workitem_id, external_comment_id, workitem_comment_id, direction, source_updated_at, source_status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{provider}, #{bindingId}, #{externalWorkitemId}, #{externalCommentId}, #{workitemCommentId}, #{direction}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, COALESCE(#{sourceStatus}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE external_comment_link SET source_updated_at = COALESCE(#{sourceUpdatedAt}, source_updated_at), source_status = COALESCE(#{sourceStatus}, 'ACTIVE') WHERE id = #{id}
